game.core.rules.readable.title: Speed and Movement
game.core.rules.readable.summary: A creature's recorded speeds define how far it can move with each movement mode; the current situation determines which mode applies.

blocks.heading: Recorded movement modes
blocks.body: Walking, climbing, flying, swimming, or another declared movement mode is read from current creature state. A speed change is written through the speed mechanic before later views use it.

blocks.heading: Movement during a turn
blocks.body: Movement and action spending are separate recorded concerns; the current encounter and terrain can constrain how the available speed is used.
